name: Mobile Pass
description: Unlock full mobile app access for 30 days. Complete tasks, manage showdowns and check the leaderboard from your phone.

name: Points Surge
description: Earn 50% more points from every task completion for the next 60 minutes. Stack multiple Surges for bigger gains.

name: Mega Surge
description: Double your task points for 30 minutes. Perfect before a focused work session.

name: Streak Shield
description: Save your day streak once. If you miss a login day this shield activates automatically — your streak stays intact.

name: Minor Surge
description: Quick 20% points boost for 30 minutes — great for a short session.

name: Power Hour
description: Earn 75% more points for 60 minutes. Best value for focused work.

name: Surge Bundle
description: Long session boost: 50% extra points for 3 hours.

name: Weekend Pass
description: Full application access for 3 days — perfect for catching up on a weekend sprint.

name: VIP Pass (1 year)
description: VIP access and premium features for 365 days.
